reviews.title: Easy Install - Works Far Better Than Original SSD - Well Packaged
reviews.comment:
Easy install to my Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Extreme laptop.  Easy to configure.  Fast!  Wow, I didn't expect reading and writing speeds to change, but they did by a LOT, compared to my original SSD.  The SSD comes well packaged and even includes a screwdriver to screw in the included screw for fastening the new drive.  Once installed, I fired the laptop up and formatted the drive.  It works just as I hoped, except for being much faster.
All in all this is a great price for an excellent product.  Well worth a full 5 stars.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: SO MUCH BETTER THAN STOCK!
reviews.comment:
This is a great read speed for a PS5! 6
Here's why your 6527MB/s reading is excellent:
* PS5 Requirements: Sony recommends a minimum sequential read speed of 5,500 MB/s for an M.2 SSD to be compatible and perform well in the PS5. Your drive is well above that requirement.
* Faster than the Internal SSD: The stock internal SSD in the PS5 has a read speed of around 5,500 MB/s. So, your new drive is actually faster than the one that came with the console, which is fantastic.
* Normal for High-End SSDs: Many high-performance M.2 SSDs rated for speeds of 7,000 MB/s or more will often show a slightly lower speed when tested inside the PS5. Your reading of 6527 MB/s is right in the range of what many users see with top-tier drives.
In short, your EDILOCA EN870 is a very good choice and that speed will ensure you have quick loading times and a smooth gaming experience.
Installed quick and easy First disconnect power then just pop the cover off, unscrew the small panel for access, take out circuit board screw and spacer, move spacer to 80 hole under not on top of EN870 board. Slide board in, fasten screw, put ps5 back together, start ps5 and format and make sure to go to storage in settings and set storage place as M.2 SSD STORAGE. Youre ready to go. I've noticed faster speeds and no lag especially on server games like MOD, ESO
